WITH METADATA AS (
    SELECT
        STORAGE.table_schema,
        STORAGE.table_name,
        STORAGE.table_type,
        (CASE WHEN SCHEMATA.schema_name IS NULL THEN 'logical' ELSE 'physical' END) AS storage_type,
        ARRAY (
        SELECT AS STRUCT arr[offset(0)] key, arr[offset(1)] value
        FROM UNNEST (REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(option_value, r'STRUCT\(("[^"]+", "[^"]+")\)')) kv,
        UNNEST ([STRUCT(SPLIT(REPLACE(kv, '"', ''), ', ') AS arr)])
        ) options,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.creation_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_creation_time,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.storage_last_modified_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND( STORAGE.active_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,
        ROUND( ( (STORAGE.active_physical_bytes - STORAGE.time_travel_physical_bytes) / POWER(1024, 3) ), 2) AS active_no_time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.time_travel_physical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_physical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_physical_gib
    FROM
        `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_STORAGE STORAGE
    LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT schema_name FROM `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS
    GROUP BY schema_name HAVING MAX (
        CASE WHEN option_name = 'storage_billing_model' AND option_value = 'PHYSICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = 1
    ) SCHEMATA
    ON STORAGE.table_schema = SCHEMATA.schema_name
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT MAX(end_time) as end_time, table_id, dataset_id,project_id
        FROM (
            SELECT end_time, destination_table, ref.table_id, ref.dataset_id, ref.project_id
            FROM `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_ORGANIZATION,
            UNNEST(referenced_tables) AS ref
            WHERE DATETIME(end_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') <= CURRENT_DATETIME('Asia/Kolkata')
            AND DATETIME(end_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') >= DATETIME_ADD(CURRENT_DATETIME('Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL -30 DAY)
        ) GROUP BY table_id, dataset_id, project_id
    ) JOBS
    ON STORAGE.table_name = JOBS.table_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT table_name, option_value FROM `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS
        WHERE option_name = "labels"
        ) LABELS
    ON STORAGE.table_name = LABELS.table_name
    -- To fetch table information only from Primary dataset and not from replicated dataset
    INNER JOIN `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA A ON STORAGE.table_schema = A.schema_name
    WHERE
        STORAGE.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
        AND NOT STORAGE.deleted
        AND JOBS.table_id is NULL
        AND STORAGE.table_name NOT IN (
            SELECT table_name FROM `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS
            GROUP BY table_name HAVING MAX (CASE WHEN option_name = 'expiration_timestamp' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
        )
    )
    SELECT
        table_schema,
        table_name,
        table_type,
        storage_type,
        options,
        table_creation_time,
        table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND(active_logical_gib, 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND(long_term_logical_gib, 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,
        ROUND(active_no_time_travel_physical_gib, 2) AS active_no_time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND(time_travel_physical_gib, 2) AS time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND(long_term_physical_gib, 2) AS long_term_physical_gib,
        ROUND(active_logical_gib * 0.02, 2) AS active_logical_cost,
        ROUND(long_term_logical_gib * 0.01, 2) AS long_term_logical_cost,
        ROUND((active_no_time_travel_physical_gib + time_travel_physical_gib) * 0.04, 2) AS active_physical_cost,
        ROUND(long_term_physical_gib * 0.02, 2) AS long_term_physical_cost
    FROM METADATA

OPTIONS(max_staleness=INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AS
SELECT MAX(end_time) as end_time, ref.table_id, ref.dataset_id, ref.project_id
FROM `region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_ORGANIZATION,
UNNEST(referenced_tables) AS ref
WHERE DATETIME(end_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') <= CURRENT_DATETIME('Asia/Kolkata')
AND DATETIME(end_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') >= DATETIME_ADD(CURRENT_DATETIME('Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL -30 DAY)
GROUP BY table_id, dataset_id, project_id;

-- Example rewrite for 27dfea51-e7e2-4c9f-a2a0-0e9e78190c2f (replace `dm-eagle` with actual project_id and dataset_id):
WITH METADATA AS (
    SELECT
        STORAGE.table_schema,
        STORAGE.table_name,
        STORAGE.table_type,
        (CASE WHEN SCHEMATA.schema_name IS NULL THEN 'logical' ELSE 'physical' END) AS storage_type,
        ARRAY (
        SELECT AS STRUCT arr[offset(0)] key, arr[offset(1)] value
        FROM UNNEST (REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(option_value, r'STRUCT\(("[^"]+", "[^"]+")\)')) kv,
        UNNEST ([STRUCT(SPLIT(REPLACE(kv, '"', ''), ', ') AS arr)])
        ) options,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.creation_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_creation_time,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.storage_last_modified_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND( STORAGE.active_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,
        ROUND( ( (STORAGE.active_physical_bytes - STORAGE.time_travel_physical_bytes) / POWER(1024, 3) ), 2) AS active_no_time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.time_travel_physical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_physical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_physical_gib
    FROM
        `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_STORAGE STORAGE
    LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT schema_name FROM `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS
    GROUP BY schema_name HAVING MAX (
        CASE WHEN option_name = 'storage_billing_model' AND option_value = 'PHYSICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = 1
    ) SCHEMATA
    ON STORAGE.table_schema = SCHEMATA.schema_name
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT end_time, table_id, dataset_id, project_id
        FROM `project_id.dataset_id.recent_referenced_tables_mv`
        WHERE DATE(end_time) >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE('Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
    ) JOBS
    ON STORAGE.table_name = JOBS.table_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT table_name, option_value FROM `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS
        WHERE option_name = "labels"
        ) LABELS
    ON STORAGE.table_name = LABELS.table_name
    -- To fetch table information only from Primary dataset and not from replicated dataset
    INNER JOIN `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA A ON STORAGE.table_schema = A.schema_name
    WHERE
        STORAGE.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
        AND NOT STORAGE.deleted
        AND JOBS.table_id is NULL
        AND STORAGE.table_name NOT IN (
            SELECT table_name FROM `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS
            GROUP BY table_name HAVING MAX (CASE WHEN option_name = 'expiration_timestamp' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
        )
    )
    SELECT
        table_schema,
        table_name,
        table_type,
        storage_type,
        options,
        table_creation_time,
        table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND(active_logical_gib, 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND(long_term_logical_gib, 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,
        ROUND(active_no_time_travel_physical_gib, 2) AS active_no_time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND(time_travel_physical_gib, 2) AS time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND(long_term_physical_gib, 2) AS long_term_physical_gib,
        ROUND(active_logical_gib * 0.02, 2) AS active_logical_cost,
        ROUND(long_term_logical_gib * 0.01, 2) AS long_term_logical_cost,
        ROUND((active_no_time_travel_physical_gib + time_travel_physical_gib) * 0.04, 2) AS active_physical_cost,
        ROUND(long_term_physical_gib * 0.02, 2) AS long_term_physical_cost
    FROM METADATA

        DATETIME(STORAGE.storage_last_modified_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND( STORAGE.active_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,
        ROUND( ( (STORAGE.active_physical_bytes - STORAGE.time_travel_physical_bytes) / POWER(1024, 3) ), 2) AS active_no_time_travel_physical_gib,

        FROM UNNEST (REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(option_value, r'STRUCT\(("[^"]+", "[^"]+")\)')) kv,
        UNNEST ([STRUCT(SPLIT(REPLACE(kv, '"', ''), ', ') AS arr)])
        ) options,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.creation_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_creation_time,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.storage_last_modified_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND( STORAGE.active_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,

            AND DATETIME(end_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') >= DATETIME_ADD(CURRENT_DATETIME('Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL -30 DAY)
        ) GROUP BY table_id, dataset_id, project_id

    LEFT JOIN (

    -- To fetch table information only from Primary dataset and not from replicated dataset
    INNER JOIN `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA A ON STORAGE.table_schema = A.schema_name
    WHERE
        STORAGE.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
        AND NOT STORAGE.deleted
        AND JOBS.table_id is NULL
        AND STORAGE.table_name NOT IN (
            SELECT table_name FROM `dm-eagle`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS
            GROUP BY table_name HAVING MAX (CASE WHEN option_name = 'expiration_timestamp' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
        )
    )
    SELECT
        table_schema,
        table_name,
        table_type,
        storage_type,
        options,
        table_creation_time,
        table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND(active_logical_gib, 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND(long_term_logical_gib, 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,
        ROUND(active_no_time_travel_physical_gib, 2) AS active_no_time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND(time_travel_physical_gib, 2) AS time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND(long_term_physical_gib, 2) AS long_term_physical_gib,
        ROUND(active_logical_gib * 0.02, 2) AS active_logical_cost,
        ROUND(long_term_logical_gib * 0.01, 2) AS long_term_logical_cost,
        ROUND((active_no_time_travel_physical_gib + time_travel_physical_gib) * 0.04, 2) AS active_physical_cost,
        ROUND(long_term_physical_gib * 0.02, 2) AS long_term_physical_cost
    FROM METADATA

WITH METADATA AS (
    SELECT
        STORAGE.table_schema,
        STORAGE.table_name,
        STORAGE.table_type,
        (CASE WHEN SCHEMATA.schema_name IS NULL THEN 'logical' ELSE 'physical' END) AS storage_type,
        ARRAY (
        SELECT AS STRUCT arr[offset(0)] key, arr[offset(1)] value
        FROM UNNEST (REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(option_value, r'STRUCT\(("[^"]+", "[^"]+")\)')) kv,
        UNNEST ([STRUCT(SPLIT(REPLACE(kv, '"', ''), ', ') AS arr)])
        ) options,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.creation_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_creation_time,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.storage_last_modified_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND( STORAGE.active_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,
        ROUND( ( (STORAGE.active_physical_bytes - STORAGE.time_travel_physical_bytes) / POWER(1024, 3) ), 2) AS active_no_time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.time_travel_physical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_physical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_physical_gib
    FROM
        `birds-training`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_STORAGE STORAGE
    LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT schema_name FROM `birds-training`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA_OPTIONS
    GROUP BY schema_name HAVING MAX (
        CASE WHEN option_name = 'storage_billing_model' AND option_value = 'PHYSICAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) = 1
    ) SCHEMATA
    ON STORAGE.table_schema = SCHEMATA.schema_name
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT MAX(end_time) as end_time, table_id, dataset_id,project_id
        FROM (
            SELECT end_time, destination_table, ref.table_id, ref.dataset_id, ref.project_id
            FROM `birds-training`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_ORGANIZATION,
            UNNEST(referenced_tables) AS ref
            WHERE DATETIME(end_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') <= CURRENT_DATETIME('Asia/Kolkata')
            AND DATETIME(end_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') >= DATETIME_ADD(CURRENT_DATETIME('Asia/Kolkata'), INTERVAL -30 DAY)
        ) GROUP BY table_id, dataset_id, project_id
    ) JOBS
    ON STORAGE.table_name = JOBS.table_id
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT table_name, option_value FROM `birds-training`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS
        WHERE option_name = "labels"
        ) LABELS
    ON STORAGE.table_name = LABELS.table_name
    -- To fetch table information only from Primary dataset and not from replicated dataset
    INNER JOIN `birds-training`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA A ON STORAGE.table_schema = A.schema_name
    WHERE
        STORAGE.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
        AND NOT STORAGE.deleted
        AND JOBS.table_id is NULL
        AND STORAGE.table_name NOT IN (
            SELECT table_name FROM `birds-training`.`region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_OPTIONS
            GROUP BY table_name HAVING MAX (CASE WHEN option_name = 'expiration_timestamp' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
        )
    )
    SELECT
        table_schema,
        table_name,
        table_type,
        storage_type,
        options,
        table_creation_time,
        table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND(active_logical_gib, 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND(long_term_logical_gib, 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,
        ROUND(active_no_time_travel_physical_gib, 2) AS active_no_time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND(time_travel_physical_gib, 2) AS time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND(long_term_physical_gib, 2) AS long_term_physical_gib,
        ROUND(active_logical_gib * 0.02, 2) AS active_logical_cost,
        ROUND(long_term_logical_gib * 0.01, 2) AS long_term_logical_cost,
        ROUND((active_no_time_travel_physical_gib + time_travel_physical_gib) * 0.04, 2) AS active_physical_cost,
        ROUND(long_term_physical_gib * 0.02, 2) AS long_term_physical_cost
    FROM METADATA

These queries involve multiple joins, subqueries, and string manipulations (REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL, SPLIT) on large system tables like JOBS_BY_ORGANIZATION, leading to high bytes billed and slot time. Centralizing this metadata collection via a scheduled query will amortize the cost of scanning system tables and allow subsequent analytical queries to run against a much smaller, pre-processed table, significantly reducing query costs and improving performance.

    -- To fetch table information only from Primary dataset and not from replicated dataset

        AND JOBS.table_id is NULL
        AND STORAGE.table_name NOT IN (

            GROUP BY table_name HAVING MAX (CASE WHEN option_name = 'expiration_timestamp' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
        )
    )
    SELECT
        table_schema,

        ROUND((active_no_time_travel_physical_gib + time_travel_physical_gib) * 0.04, 2) AS active_physical_cost,
        ROUND(long_term_physical_gib * 0.02, 2) AS long_term_physical_cost
    FROM METADATA

        STORAGE.table_name,
        STORAGE.table_type,
        (CASE WHEN SCHEMATA.schema_name IS NULL THEN 'logical' ELSE 'physical' END) AS storage_type,
        ARRAY (
            SELECT AS STRUCT arr[offset(0)] key, arr[offset(1)] value
            FROM UNNEST (REGEXP_EXTRACT_ALL(option_value, r'STRUCT\\(\"[^\"]+\", \"[^\"]+\\"\\)\\)')) kv,
            UNNEST ([STRUCT(SPLIT(REPLACE(kv, '"', ''), ', ') AS arr)])
        ) options,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.creation_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_creation_time,
        DATETIME(STORAGE.storage_last_modified_time, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS table_last_modified_time,
        ROUND( STORAGE.active_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS active_logical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_logical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_logical_gib,
        ROUND( ( (STORAGE.active_physical_bytes - STORAGE.time_travel_physical_bytes) / POWER(1024, 3) ), 2) AS active_no_time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.time_travel_physical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS time_travel_physical_gib,
        ROUND( STORAGE.long_term_physical_bytes / POWER(1024, 3), 2) AS long_term_physical_gib

    LEFT JOIN (

        FROM (
            SELECT end_time, destination_table, ref.table_id, ref.dataset_id, ref.project_id
            FROM `region-US`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_ORGANIZATION,
            UNNEST(referenced_tables) AS ref
            WHERE end_time <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
